catalog_scope: Primary public sources supporting the critic-final proposal. Capture hashes identify HTTP response bodies, not semantic truth. Stable/current documentation aliases are identified as mutable. Candidate source-context captures are the immutable handoff; critic recaptures are listed where obtained.

sources.name: nbformat 5.10.4 notebook format description
sources.pin: Versioned nbformat documentation v5.10.4; page identifies this documentation version.
facts_used: Notebook JSON stores ordered cells; code cells can store execution_count and saved output structures including streams, MIME bundles, execute results and errors.
sources.applicability: Document format only. It does not describe complete kernel mutations, a durable execution ledger or current runtime state.

sources.name: nbclient NotebookClient implementation
sources.pin: Git tag v0.10.2; exact raw source file.
facts_used: Executes notebook cells in notebook order; default skip tag is skip-execution; force_raise_errors defaults false; raises-exception tags and allow_errors can permit continuation; offers hooks/timeouts; display_id updates can mutate an output associated with an earlier cell.
sources.applicability: Execution orchestration behavior in this source version. It does not isolate code, guarantee deterministic replay, capture all file dependencies or establish a compatible full package lock.

sources.name: DuckDB issue #25164: parallel CSV duplicate rows
sources.pin: Issue #25164 as captured 2026-10-06; report references 1.4.4, 1.5.2 and 1.5.5; issue is closed.
facts_used: Issue reports byte-identical valid duplicate rows in parallel scans on a buffer-boundary CRCRLF case and silent result corruption; describes a possible separate leading-LF symptom.
sources.applicability: Issue report, not a release guarantee. Does not say the separate possible leading-LF symptom was fixed by the same patch.

sources.name: DuckDB PR #25232: scanner fix
locator: body: bug mechanism and fix condition
facts_used: The patch adds an early return in ProcessOverBufferValue for a carry-on boundary case where the preceding buffer already counted the row; PR reports its regression test passed on a relassert build.
sources.applicability: The fix is evidenced on the v2.0-cyanoptera merge. PR's test report is not an independently executed release test and does not establish inclusion in v1.5.6.

sources.name: DuckDB regression test at PR #25232 merge commit
facts_used: Test source constructs the CRCRLF split at one exact buffer boundary, asserts 60 parallel/sequential rows and unique IDs 39/40, checks a mid-buffer case, and excludes Windows.
sources.applicability: Regression-source evidence at a pinned merge commit; candidate did not execute the test harness. Not broad parser coverage or release artifact evidence.

locator.name: Jupyter Client transport security for kernels
locator.pin: Captured stable page identifies jupyter_client 8.10.0 documentation; page notes setting introduced in 8.9. Stable URL is mutable.
facts_used: Jupyter kernel ZMQ sockets are local TCP by default and lack transport encryption; other host processes able to reach those ports can read messages. CurveZMQ configuration is documented for compatible kernels.
locator.applicability: Transport-security documentation only. Product containment recommendation is to keep client/manager/kernel inside a private namespace; this source does not provide process isolation or filesystem restrictions.
